description: Wait for something to happen instead of polling: returns as soon as a new signal is published (on Pro also when a signal closes, or when short signals pause or resume), or after the timeout with an empty list. Call it again with the returned cursor to keep watching. The first call (no "after") starts from now and returns nothing older. Use get_signals for what is open right now; use this to react to what comes next. Free plan: new signals with coin and direction, levels null.

after.description: The cursor from the previous call. Omit on the first call.

apiKey.description: API key — omit if your client was installed with it (X-Api-Key header or ?apiKey=).

minConfidence.description: Only signals at or above this confidence (1–100). Pro.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait before returning empty (max 50).

name: wait_for_signal
title: Wait For The Next Signal
